records.command:
tail -10 .local/source-preservation/native.log
cat > .dip/tools/verify-extract-preservation.mjs <<'JS'
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
for (const [cmd,args] of [
 ['cargo',['test','-p','opencut-editor-api','--test','classic_podcast','--test','classic_transcription','--test','classic_update','--test','classic_archive']],
 ['node',['classic/scripts/test-web.mjs','src/ai/__tests__/podcast-task.test.ts','src/ai/__tests__/podcast-plan.test.ts','src/core/managers/__tests__/canonical-command-manager.test.ts','--timeout=240000','--test-timeout=120000','--jobs=1']]
]) { const r=spawnSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'}); if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status??1); }
JS
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('.dip/config.json');d=json.loads(p.read_text());d['verification']['extract-preservation']={'command':['node','.dip/tools/verify-extract-preservation.mjs'],'timeoutMs':480000};p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
node .dip/tools/verify-extract-preservation.mjs > .local/source-preservation/check.log 2>&1
